title: The Water Magician
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Manga adaptation of a light-novel isekai. Ryo is reincarnated in a fantasy world with water magic and dropped alone in monster-filled wilds with a shack, a knife and some food; he must survive, and later meets a headless horseman, a dragon and a castaway swordsman as his journey widens (J-Novel Club blurb via AniList and MangaUpdates).
life_message: Steady self-reliance, practice and curiosity let a person carve out a peaceful life and grow strong.
